n83e8d11fbc.headline: Kepco ‘earnings shock’ shaken by fuel costs… Will electricity rates rise again next year?
n83e8d11fbc.summary: Korea Electric Power Corporation recorded significant operating losses in Q3 due to soaring fuel prices, with annual losses expected to reach trillions of won. Rising international energy prices may lead to higher electricity rates next year.
n83e8d11fbc.why: Kepco is South Korea's largest electric utility, and its financial health and pricing decisions affect the national energy market and economy.
n83e8d11fbc.why_moved: Rising fuel costs increased operating expenses, causing losses and raising concerns about future electricity rate hikes, affecting investor sentiment.

n6c8f483be0.headline: Sri Lanka confident of not defaulting on its debt, says Finance Minister
n6c8f483be0.summary: Sri Lanka's finance minister states the country is confident it will not default on its debt and plans to improve repayment conditions.
n6c8f483be0.why: Debt sustainability affects Sri Lanka's economic stability and access to international financial markets.
